Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

translations.web: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
translations.bsb: For you gladly put up with fools, since you are so wise.
translations.kjv: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
translations.asv: For ye bear with the foolish gladly, being wise yourselves.
